brief_summary: This study is a multi-center, open label, randomized controlled trial that main purpose of this study is to evaluate the differences of glucose control and weight loss between Beinaglutide and Dulaglutide in type 2 diabetes with overweight or or Obesity.
brief_title: The Effects of Glucose Control and Weight Loss Between Beinaglutide and Dulaglutide in Type 2 Diabetes With Overweight or Obesity.

official_title: A Randomized Controlled, Open-label, Multi-center Study With 16-week Beinaglutide or Dulaglutide Assessing Effects on Glucose Control and Weight Loss in Type 2 Diabetes With Overweight or Obesity.
